query: SELECT partition_name, COUNT(*) AS transactions, SUM(is_laundering) AS positives FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN transaction_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-08-04 00:00:00' AND transaction_time < TIMESTAMP '2022-08-08 00:00:00' THEN 'development' WHEN transaction_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-08-10 00:00:00' AND transaction_time < TIMESTAMP '2022-08-13 00:00:00' THEN 'validation' WHEN transaction_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-08-15 00:00:00' AND transaction_time < TIMESTAMP '2022-08-18 00:00:00' THEN 'test' ELSE 'embargo' END AS partition_name, is_laundering FROM IBM_AML.hi_large_transactions WHERE transaction_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-08-04 00:00:00' AND transaction_time < TIMESTAMP '2022-08-18 00:00:00') q GROUP BY partition_name ORDER BY partition_name
cost_scope: Existing Azure VM compute; no LLM API, no new cloud resources
test_labels: Aggregate enrollment QA only; no per-case test outcomes inspected
